description: The header's thinking-effort drop-down: the effort levels the current model supports, a tick on the current one, opened centred under its button.

parts.name: levels
parts.shows: Only the levels the model says it supports, in the model's order, from: No thinking (off), Low effort, Medium effort, High effort, Extra-high effort, Max effort. The model's default level is shown until one is chosen. Models that think on this Mac keep their own level, separate from Claude's.

actions.does: Sets the thinking effort (effortLevel applied to the running chat) and notes quietly "thinking effort → <label>". Changing the model re-reads the level (the CLI may change or drop it)

states.name: unavailable
states.shows: A model with no effort setting: the box shows "Effort", is greyed out and can't be opened; tooltip "<model> has no effort setting"

states.name: hidden
states.shows: Hidden for a program that has no effort levels at all
